title: Dolbeault Cohomology Growth under Curvature Rank Bounds
summary: Let $L$ be a smooth Hermitian holomorphic line bundle on a compact complex manifold $X$ of dimension $n$, and let $r$ be its maximal curvature rank. For every fixed holomorphic vector bundle $E$, we prove $h^q(X,L^p\otimes E)=O_\varepsilon(p^{r+\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$ and every Dolbeault degree, with the sharp bounds $h^0,h^n=O(p^r)$ at the endpoints. The curvature may have variable rank and arbitrary signature, and no global foliation or Kähler assumption is imposed.
